setlist.title: Stuck Inside Of Mobile With The Memphis Blues Again

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodleloo** (3 reviews): Rare choice as second set opener, according to the reviewer; Reviewer finds it anemic and Sugar Magnolia merely standard [11][16][19]
- **Playing In The Band** (3 reviews): Nearly twenty minutes of aggressive jamming, shifting moods, and an attempted Terrapin that emerges from space instead; Jerry's voice began failing, so the band opted for a roughly twenty-minute Playin' [11][14][20]
- **Feel Like A Stranger** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls it the best version heard, and rates Stuck Inside of Mobile the best too; Groove built steadily to a peak [13][15]
- **Valley Road** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer feels the song suited the players on stage; Hornsby's contribution on this tune closed the first set [6][22]
- **High Time** (1 review): Reviewer says High Time was strong, and Mississippi and Crazy Fingers were notable [21]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): Lyric trouble during the song, though only a speed bump [20]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Reviewer hears Phil or Bobby not following the flow at the end, seeming eager for Sugar Magnolia [17]

## Setlist highlights

- **Maggie's Far**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **Valley Road**: rare: 7 archived performances [23]

## The recordings

- **gd90-12-30.sbd.wiley.11669.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 174 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd90-12-30.sbd.miller.22025.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 173 min; rated 4/5 by 13 [2]. Said about its sound: Fine-sounding recording; Bruce's piano and accordion lift the show noticeably; Reviewer describes the sound as great; Seamless transition between discs two and three [2][17][22]
- **gd1990-12-30.127333.nak304.bowen.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 172 min [6]
- **gd1990-12-30.138190.BK4001.fob.Darrouch.Ammons.t-flac16**: source not stated; 9 songs; 75 min [10]. Said about its sound: Minor hand clapping and yelping cleaned up between songs [10]

## Around the show

- Vince ad-libbed during Maggie's Farm when he forgot the words [14]
- Healy had feedback trouble, and the drums dropped out briefly during Memphis Blues [15]
- Jerry sang through a failing voice but compensated with nice picking until the end [17]
- Jerry's voice declining but fingers nimble; drummers described as feisty [20]
- Attendee came with friends from Canada; one of the first shows he attended, aged 18 [21]
- Reviewer notes a few flubs and a measured, pleasant performance near the year's end [22]
- Taper recorded all four shows of the NYE run; he misses Brent and praises Hornsby's color [6]
- An FOB bust ended the team's taping; only the first set survives [10]
- Reviewer ranks it the best of 1990 apart from Nassau [13]
- Jerry's voice trouble carries into the following night [14]
- Earlier nights recalled by the attendee: Hamza El Din on the first, He's Gone on the second; a day off helped the band [15]
- Reviewer prefers the 9-20-1990 Garden show over this one [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd90-12-30.sbd.wiley.11669.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>??>DAT>CDR>WAV>SHN [1]. Also: Soundboard to unknown generation to DAT to CDR; seeded to Etree by T. Wiley [1]
- **gd90-12-30.sbd.miller.22025.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Transferred from DAT to CD in 2000; static pops removed using Cool Edit Pro [2]
- **gd1990-12-30.127333.nak304.bowen.flac16**: taped by Jeff Bowen; transferred by Jeff Bowen; source: Source: Nakamichi CM-300 CP-4 Shotgun Capsules > Sony TC-153SD Master (SA-X100) [6]
- **gd1990-12-30.138190.BK4001.fob.Darrouch.Ammons.t-flac16**: taped by Rob Darroch; transferred by John Ammons and Joe Noel; source: flac16/48kHz ; Set 1 Rob Darroch recording (hand held): B&K 4011 at 110 degrees ORTF on Schoeps t-bat > Pro-Link Cables > Mod Neumann PS > Panasonic SV255;… [10]. Also: Recorded by Rob Darroch with a BK4001 front-of-board setup; DAT clones provided by John Ammons [10]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oakland Coliseum Arena - December 30, 1990](https://www.dead.net/show/december-30-1990) [24]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oakland Coliseum Arena - December 31, 1990](https://www.dead.net/show/december-31-1990) [25]
